body:

B (leave a contradiction inside one file the runner reads) fails the anti-confusion purpose the checklist exists for, at the cost of a two-line edit. Premise gate: land after PR #10412 so the wording aligns with the sibling item's final text. Co-location note: #10416 edits the same checklist area — fold or serialize at dispatch. Size/model suggestion: S, sonnet.
